flows.title: Create a table
steps: In the project's Dashboard, go to the Table Editor page.
Click New Table, give the table a name, and click Save. Use lowercase and underscores rather than spaces in the name.
Click New Column, give the column a name and a data type, and click Save. Adding columns while creating the table is best practice.

flows.title: Run SQL in the SQL Editor
steps: In the project's dashboard, open the SQL Editor.

flows.title: Invite someone to the organization
steps: Send an invite to the person's email address. A project-scoped role can be given for one project when inviting, and for more projects after they accept.
The invite is valid for 24 hours.
